paragraphs: Forward Thinking Systems sells fleet management technology that puts vehicle tracking, cameras, compliance, routing, driver coaching and asset management on one platform. The product itself is a browser-based console for an entire fleet.

Vehicle and driver data arrives in real time, including location, speed, ignition status and hours-of-service duty status. More than sixty built-in reports break that data down by fleet, vehicle and driver. The camera product saves footage automatically when it detects behavior such as distracted driving, hard braking or texting. A driver-facing app lets drivers watch their own scorecard, review those events, and dispute the ones they consider inaccurate. Routing is handled by a separate optimization tool for building efficient multi-stop routes.

Government and public sector fleets are one of the segments the company addresses. For those buyers it points to real-time GPS built for emergency operations. Asset tracking extends past vehicles to trailers, heavy equipment and containers. The software also integrates with fuel card providers named on the site.

quote.text: Every vehicle tracked. Every driver dispatched. Every event captured.
